blocks.text: Peshab banne ka pehla qadam ek physical (tabai, kimiyai nahin) amal hai jise glomerular filtration (ya ultrafiltration) kehte hain. Efferent arteriole afferent arteriole se patli (narrow) hoti hai. Is farq ki wajah se glomerulus ki capillaries mein khoon nisbatan zyada dabao (high pressure) par rehta hai. Yeh zyada dabao pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur mukhtalif namak (Na⁺, K⁺, Cl⁻) ko khoon se dhakel kar Bowman's capsule mein bhej deta hai. Khoon ke mayi (fluid) hisse ka taqreeban paanchwan hissa (20%) chhan kar Bowman's capsule mein jata hai; ise glomerular filtrate kehte hain. Plasma proteins (maslan albumin aur globulins) aur khoon ke cells itne bare hain ke capillaries ki deewar se nahin guzar sakte, is liye yeh khoon hi mein reh jate hain.
